finding.description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_unsolicited_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_unsolicited_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted an unsolicited/IdP-initiated SAMLResponse without a prior SP-initiated flow, indicating step skipping and broken flow coherence.

finding.sequence_description: Same-flow principal swap: initiate one SP-initiated flow, then attempt to submit two different SAMLResponses (different NameID principals) against the same RelayState. Expected: only one completion is allowed; second should be rejected as invalid/consumed state (order/atomicity).
finding.description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_second_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_second_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted a second SAMLResponse completion against the same RelayState with a different principal, indicating non-atomic flow completion and potential cross-principal splicing.

sequence.description: Same-flow principal swap: initiate one SP-initiated flow, then attempt to submit two different SAMLResponses (different NameID principals) against the same RelayState. Expected: only one completion is allowed; second should be rejected as invalid/consumed state (order/atomicity).
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I3: Dex might allow multiple completions of the same SP-initiated flow state (RelayState) with different principals, enabling cross-principal splicing or non-atomic flow completion.

oracle_checks.violation_description: Control first completion of SP-initiated flow failed; cannot evaluate atomicity of subsequent completion attempt.

finding.sequence_description: Atomicity/order test: complete a valid SAML login for victim, then attempt to reuse the same RelayState to complete a second login for attacker (state reuse / step reordering).
finding.description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_second_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_second_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted a second SAMLResponse using a RelayState that was already consumed by a successful login (non-atomic flow completion / state reuse).

sequence.description: Atomicity/order test: complete a valid SAML login for victim, then attempt to reuse the same RelayState to complete a second login for attacker (state reuse / step reordering).
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I3: A single SP-initiated flow state must be one-time and consumed atomically; after successful completion, reusing the same RelayState for a second principal must be rejected.

oracle_checks.violation_description: Control SAML login failed; cannot interpret state-reuse results as a flow-coherence issue.
Dex accepted a second SAMLResponse using a RelayState that was already consumed by a successful login (non-atomic flow completion / state reuse).
